findings.issue: The component resets imageLoadFailed to false whenever imageUrl changes, so an image that previously failed (@error) gets a fresh chance to render when the author edits the URL to a new valid value. No test exercises this reset branch. Litmus: deleting the watch(imageUrl, () => imageLoadFailed.value = false) line leaves every current test green, so the recovery-after-error behavior is unprotected against regression.
findings.recommendation: Add a test: mount SEND_IMAGE with imageUrl 'https://cdn.example/broken.png', trigger('error') on the img, settle, assert placeholder shown; then setProps the step to imageUrl 'https://cdn.example/fixed.png', settle, and assert img[data-test=funnel-preview-image] exists again with src === the new URL and placeholder gone. This pins the imageLoadFailed reset path.

findings.issue: DOM-order ('image ABOVE caption') is asserted via panelHtml.indexOf('funnel-preview-image') < indexOf('funnel-preview-rendered') on the serialized HTML string. This works correctly here, but a string-position heuristic is slightly brittle (e.g. if a future class/comment also contained the substring it could misfire). It is a position-of-substring check rather than a structural sibling-order check.
findings.recommendation: Optional hardening: assert order structurally, e.g. collect wrapper.findAll('[data-test]') or compare element positions via compareDocumentPosition, instead of substring index on raw HTML. Not blocking — current assertion is correct for the present template.

notes: Empirically verified (not just by inspection). All 15 tests pass against the committed (new) component. Reverting the component to its pre-commit state (2994c3b^) and re-running makes EXACTLY the 4 behavior-specific new tests fail: valid-imageUrl renders with that src above the caption (line 133-area set), empty-caption image-only, blank/whitespace-URL placeholder (no broken ), and @error placeholder. The 5th new test (SEND_MESSAGE/MENU/DELAY -> no ) stays green on old code as expected — it is a true negative control (goes red if an image is rendered for non-SEND_IMAGE types), not a tautology. Assertions are real and non-tautological: actual src value is checked (not mere existence), placeholder/caption co-presence and non-empty text are asserted, and the @error case triggers a real DOM 'error' event that drives the reactive imageLoadFailed flip rather than asserting a mock. The no-v-html source guard and the caption/placeholder/sample-data/heading/empty-state tests are unaffected and all pass. i18n keys previewImageUnavailable and previewImageAlt exist in both en.json and uk.json, so placeholder/alt assertions resolve to real strings. Two minor, non-blocking findings: the imageLoadFailed-reset-on-url-change branch is untested, and DOM-order uses a substring-index heuristic. Coverage is adequate; verdict approved.
